title: Academy Training
imageAlt: BSSFC Academy Training session with certified coaches
description: Our Academy Training programme provides structured, age-appropriate football coaching designed to develop technical skills, tactical understanding, physical fitness and the right mental attitude. Delivered by AFC/AIFF-licensed coaches, it covers dribbling, passing, shooting, set-pieces and match play in a safe, disciplined environment. Players are nurtured through a proven curriculum that mirrors professional football development pathways, giving every child the platform to reach their full potential.
features: AFC / AIFF licensed and certified coaches
Technical skill development — dribbling, passing, shooting
Video analysis sessions for advanced groups

process.title: Assessment
process.desc: Every player begins with a skill and fitness assessment to place them in the right age-group batch.

process.title: Structured Training
process.desc: Weekly sessions covering technical, tactical, physical, and psychological pillars of the game.

process.title: Match Practice
process.desc: Regular in-house and external fixtures to put skills into competitive practice.

process.title: Review & Progression
process.desc: Quarterly reviews and promotion to the next age band based on performance and development.

faqs.q: What age groups does the academy accept?
faqs.a: We accept players from age 5 (Under-7) through to senior level (25+). Each group has its own curriculum tailored to their developmental stage.

faqs.q: How many days per week are training sessions?
faqs.a: Academy training runs 6 days a week. Specific batch timings vary by venue and age group — contact us for the schedule at your nearest centre.
Yes. All BSSFC coaches hold AFC or AIFF coaching licences and undergo regular CPD training.

title: School / University Coaching And Scholarship Program
imageAlt: BSSFC School and University football coaching and scholarship program
description: BSSFC partners with schools and universities across Bangalore, Pondicherry, Chennai, Nilgiris and Karnataka to deliver high-quality football coaching programmes and scholarship opportunities for talented players. Our coaches integrate football development within the academic schedule, helping students balance education and sport at the highest level. We identify gifted players early, nurture them through our academy system, and open pathways to state, national, and international competitions.
features: Scholarship opportunities for talented and underprivileged players
AIFF-aligned curriculum delivered on school/campus grounds
State and national level competition exposure
Expansion across Pondicherry, Chennai, Nilgiris and Karnataka

process.title: Partnership
process.desc: BSSFC signs a coaching partnership with your school or university to provide structured football within the campus.

process.title: Talent Identification
process.desc: Our scouts assess all interested students and identify players for intensive development.

process.title: Coaching & Development
process.desc: Licensed coaches deliver sessions on campus, coordinated around the academic calendar.

process.title: Competition & Scholarships
process.desc: Top performers are entered into state/national competitions, with scholarship packages offered to deserving players.

faqs.q: How does BSSFC partner with our school?
faqs.a: We sign a formal coaching partnership agreement. Our coaches visit your campus on agreed days and conduct structured sessions for your students at no disruption to academic schedules.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for a scholarship?
faqs.a: Scholarships are awarded on a merit and/or need basis to talented players identified through our scouting process. Both boys and girls are eligible.

faqs.q: Which cities do you operate in?
faqs.a: We currently operate across Bangalore, Pondicherry, Chennai, Nilgiris and Karnataka, with new locations being added regularly.

title: Age Wise Progression
imageAlt: BSSFC Age Wise Progression framework from U7 to senior football
description: BSSFC's Age Wise Progression framework ensures every player develops at the right pace for their age and ability. The programme is structured in age bands — U7, U9, U11, U13, U15, U17, U20 and Senior — each with its own technical, tactical, physical and psychological goals aligned with AIFF and KSFA guidelines. This structured pathway is what separates hobbyists from future professionals: a clear, measurable roadmap from a child's first touch to competitive senior football.

process.title: Entry Assessment
process.desc: New players are assessed and placed in the correct age band regardless of previous experience.

process.title: IDP Creation
process.desc: An Individual Development Plan is created for each player, tracking technical, tactical, physical and mental goals.

process.title: Structured Training
process.desc: Band-specific curriculum delivered by coaches certified for that age group.

process.title: Promotion
process.desc: Players are reviewed quarterly and promoted to the next band when ready, based on performance benchmarks.

faqs.q: What if my child is older but new to football?
faqs.a: We assess each player individually. A late-starter may train with a younger age band initially and progress quickly based on their development.

faqs.q: Is there a women's progression pathway?
faqs.a: Yes. BSSFC runs a dedicated women's development programme aligned to the same age-band framework, with women's league participation.
Formal assessments happen quarterly. Coaches also monitor progress continuously during training sessions.

title: Summer Camp
imageAlt: BSSFC Summer Football Camp with young players
description: BSSFC Summer Football Camps run across multiple centres in Bangalore during school vacation periods. Combining technical skill workshops, 5-a-side mini leagues, agility circuits, and fun football activities, the camp is designed to keep young players active, engaged, and improving throughout the summer. All skill levels are welcome — from complete beginners to academy players wanting extra reps during the holidays.
features: Open to all skill levels — beginners to advanced
Technical skill workshops by certified coaches
Certificate of completion for all participants
Talent scouting opportunities for the academy

process.title: Register
process.desc: Register online or at any BSSFC centre. Batch allocation is based on age and skill level.

process.title: Skill Workshops
process.desc: Daily structured coaching sessions focusing on a different technical theme each day.

process.title: Mini Leagues & Games
process.desc: Evening sessions include fun 5-a-side leagues to apply skills in a match setting.

process.title: Friday Tournaments
process.desc: Every Friday features a mini-tournament with awards, certificates and an end-of-camp celebration.

faqs.a: Summer camps typically run in April–May and October–November to coincide with school vacation periods in Bangalore. Register early as spots fill fast.
Absolutely. The camp welcomes all levels from complete beginners to competitive academy players. Groups are split by age and ability for appropriate coaching.

faqs.q: What does my child need to bring?
faqs.a: Football boots (or sports shoes for beginners), shin guards, a water bottle, and comfortable sports clothing. Balls are provided.
